claims.text: Theo tinh thần **thực dụng luận** (*pragmatism*) của Peirce và William James, một niềm tin không tạo ra khác biệt nào trong hành động thì có nghĩa gì?

sources.quote: the so-called ‘classical pragmatists’ Charles Sanders Peirce (1839–1914), who first defined and defended the view, and his close friend and colleague William James (1842–1910)
Consider what effects, which might conceivably have practical bearings, we conceive the object of our conception to have.
Unless some ‘practical difference’ would follow from one or the other side’s being correct, the dispute is idle.

sources.quote: The impartiality which, in contemplation, is the unalloyed desire for truth, is the very same quality of mind which, in action, is justice

claims.text: Và ông không coi nhẹ nhu cầu vật chất; ông chỉ nói chúng không phải là tất cả (XV.3).

sources.quote: If all men were well off, if poverty and disease had been reduced to their lowest possible point, there would still remain much to be done to produce a valuable society; and even in the existing world the goods of the mind are at least as important as the goods of the body.

claims.text: Các nhà triết học phân tích về sau, kể cả [Wittgenstein](../triet-gia/wittgenstein.md), cho rằng nhiều vấn đề triết học nảy sinh từ chỗ hiểu lầm cách ngôn ngữ vận hành.

sources.quote: The book deals with the problems of philosophy and shows, as I believe, that the method of formulating these problems rests on the misunderstanding of the logic of our language.
In both cases philosophy serves, first, as critique of language. It is through analyzing language’s illusive power that the philosopher can expose the traps of meaningless philosophical formulations.
